title: dwi2response
description:
Estimate response function(s) for spherical deconvolution.
dwi2response offers different algorithms for performing various types of response function estimation. The name of the algorithm must appear as the first argument on the command-line after â€˜dwi2responseâ€™. The subsequent arguments and options depend on the particular algorithm being invoked.
Each algorithm available has its own help page, including necessary references; e.g. to see the help page of the 'fa' algorithm, type 'dwi2response fa'.

algorithm.description: Select the algorithm to be used to complete the script operation; additional details and options become available once an algorithm is nominated. Options are: dhollander, fa, manual, msmt_5tt, tax, tournier.
algorithm.title: algorithm

grad.description: Provide the diffusion gradient table in MRtrix format
grad.title: grad

bvecs.description: Provide the diffusion-weighted gradient scheme used in the acquisition in FSL bvecs/bvals format files. If a diffusion gradient scheme is present in the input image header, the data provided with this option will be instead used.
bvecs.title: bvecs

bvals.description: Provide the diffusion-weighted gradient scheme used in the acquisition in FSL bvecs/bvals format files. If a diffusion gradient scheme is present in the input image header, the data provided with this option will be instead used.
bvals.title: bvals

fslgrad.description: Provide the diffusion gradient table in FSL bvecs/bvals format
fslgrad.title: fslgrad

mask.description: Only process voxels within the specified binary brain mask image.
mask.title: mask

voxels.description: Output an image showing the final voxel selection(s)
voxels.title: voxels

shells.description: b-value(s) to use in response function estimation (comma-separated list in case of multiple b-values, b=0 must be included explicitly)
shells.title: shells

lmax.description: maximum harmonic degree(s) for response function estimation (comma-separated list in case of multiple b-values).
lmax.title: lmax

nocleanup.description: do not delete intermediate files during script execution, and do not delete scratch directory at script completion.
nocleanup.title: nocleanup

scratch.description: manually specify the path in which to generate the scratch directory.
scratch.title: scratch

continue.description: continue the script from a previous execution; must provide the scratch directory path, and the name of the last successfully-generated file.
continue.title: continue

quiet.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.
quiet.title: quiet

force.description: force overwrite of output files (caution: using the same file as input and output might cause unexpected behaviour).
force.title: force

nthreads.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
nthreads.title: nthreads

key.description: temporarily set the value of an MRtrix config file entry.
key.title: key

value.description: temporarily set the value of an MRtrix config file entry.
value.title: value

config.description: temporarily set the value of an MRtrix config file entry.
config.title: config

help.description: display this information page and exit.
help.title: help
